The shortfall began after a change in intake water after a neighboring discharge permit was revised. The farm team's leading theories are underfeeding or overcrowding, so they favor more feed and lower density. Fish have been seen flaring their gills and crowding the inflow. Routine water-quality panels read broadly within range. The feeding, stocking, filtration, and aeration systems are all adjustable, and treatment equipment is available. You have a limited number of experiments; you may measure quantities and apply available controls or treatments, alone or in combination. Determine what is really driving the loss and what to do about it.
